_comment: Turns on brand-lint from the miragon-brand plugin for the whole suite: as the Claude Code hook on every file Claude writes and for a manual run from the root. The hook takes the nearest .miragon/brand.json and never merges, so this is the one file; none goes under modelers/ (the new-modeler template carries its own for the repository it starts). The modelers are English (design guide section 2), so the German copy rules are off: du (A1), umlauts (A3), German passive (A4), German claim (A7) and gender forms (A11). C5 (one language per tool) stays on, as do em dashes as connectors (A2), spellings (A10), the anti-slop patterns (S*) and the palette, token and dark-mode rules. Ignored: CHANGELOGs, which release-please writes; the third-party notices, generated from the bundled licences, and the unchanged Apache License text they quote; the Miragon docs kit in docs/.vitepress/miragon/, vendored unchanged and checked at its source; tests, e2e suites and snapshots, whose data breaks rules on purpose; fixtures, which also hold the shell's vendored design-system files. brand-lint skips the vendored *.generated.* tokens and cd-canvas.css by itself.
